import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    static int L, n, k, Mo, len, bit[], fac[], inv[], cnt[], g[][], f[][], h[], p[];
    static final int N = 262144;

    static int pwr(int x, int y) {
        long z = 1;
        long xx = x;
        int yy = y;
        while (yy > 0) {
            if ((yy & 1) != 0) z = (z * xx) % Mo;
            xx = (xx * xx) % Mo;
            yy >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) z;
    }

    static void inc(int[] a, int y) {
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            a[i] = a[i] + y >= Mo ? a[i] + y - Mo : a[i] + y;
        }
    }

    static void dec(int[] a, int y) {
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            a[i] = a[i] - y < 0 ? a[i] - y + Mo : a[i] - y;
        }
    }

    static void FWT(int[] a, int len) {
        for (int i = 1; i < len; i <<= 1) {
            for (int j = 0; j < len; j += i << 1) {
                for (int k = 0; k < i; k++) {
                    inc(new int[]{a[j + k + i]}, a[j + k]);
                    a[j + k + i] = (a[j + k + i] + Mo - a[j + k]) % Mo;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void IFWT(int[] a, int len) {
        for (int i = 1; i < len; i <<= 1) {
            for (int j = 0; j < len; j += i << 1) {
                for (int k = 0; k < i; k++) {
                    dec(new int[]{a[j + k + i]}, a[j + k]);
                    a[j + k + i] = (a[j + k + i] + Mo) % Mo;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void get_ln(int[] a, int[] b, int n) {
        Arrays.fill(b, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            b[i] = (int)((long) a[i] * i % Mo);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                b[i] = (int)((b[i] + Mo - (long) b[j] * a[i - j] % Mo * j % Mo) % Mo);
            }
            b[i] = (int)((long) b[i] * pwr(i, Mo - 2) % Mo);
        }
    }

    static void get_exp(int[] a, int[] b, int n) {
        Arrays.fill(b, 0);
        b[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            b[i] = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                b[i] = (int)((b[i] + (long) a[j] * b[i - j] % Mo * j % Mo) % Mo);
            }
            b[i] = (int)((long) b[i] * pwr(i, Mo - 2) % Mo);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        L = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        Mo = sc.nextInt();

        int all = pwr(k, L);
        if ((L & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(all);
            return;
        }

        fac = new int[L + 1];
        inv = new int[L + 1];
        cnt = new int[L + 1];
        bit = new int[20];
        g = new int[20][N];
        f = new int[20][N];
        h = new int[20];
        p = new int[20];

        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= L; i++) {
            fac[i] = (int)((long) fac[i - 1] * i % Mo);
        }
        inv[L] = pwr(fac[L], Mo - 2);
        for (int i = L - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            inv[i] = (int)((long) inv[i + 1] * (i + 1) % Mo);
        }
        for (int s = 1; s <= L; s++) {
            cnt[s] = cnt[s ^ (s & -s)] + 1;
        }
        int nCount = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            if (((L >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                bit[++nCount] = 1 << i;
            }
        }
        n = nCount;
        len = 1 << n;

        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            int s = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (((i >> (j - 1)) & 1) != 0) s += bit[j];
            }
            g[cnt[i]][i] = inv[s];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++) {
            if (i <= 18) {
                FWT(g[i], len);
            }
        }

        for (int s = 0; s < len; s++) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                h[i] = g[i][s];
            }
            get_ln(h, p, n);
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                p[i] = (int)((long) p[i] * k % Mo);
            }
            get_exp(p, h, n);
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                f[i][s] = h[i];
            }
        }

        IFWT(f[n], len);
        int ans = (int)((long) f[n][len - 1] * fac[L] % Mo);
        ans = (all - ans + Mo) % Mo;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
